title: How to add an external power amplifier (PA) to the RF output of an ST25Rx00 reader
content:
I am currently working with an ST25R300 reader IC and would like to increase the available RF power at the antenna in order to achieve a higher field strength/read range.

I only need ISO/IEC 15693 modulation.

I need about 5-8 watts of output power.

Is it possible to drive a H bridge driver IC with the push pull output of the ST25R300? And what about deadtime etc.

Are there any reference designs or application notes from ST showing an ST25R device combined with an external PA?

 

Thank you in advance!
tags: ST25 NFC - RFID readers - ST25Rx00 series
